title: Mexican Congress hearing on Peruvian alien mummies

tellings.quote: the next day there's this like Mexico City Congress thing about uh these Peruvian, you know, uh alien mummies or whatever.

plain: In 2023 the Mexican Congress in Mexico City is said to have held a session about mummies from Peru that were presented as alien. Michels mentions it only in passing, as having happened "the next day" after another event, and calls them "alien mummies or whatever." He gives no more detail about what was shown.
